hook_text: 30 newtons plus 50 newtons equals... 20? That's vectors.
clip_script: Vectors in one dimension are added with a sign convention. Choose a positive direction, declare it, and stick to it. Let us choose: east is positive. Then 30 newtons east is plus 30. And 50 newtons west — the opposite way — is minus 50. Add: plus 30 plus negative 50 equals negative 20. Negative, in our convention, means westward. The resultant is 20 newtons west. The two forces fought. Thirty newtons of eastward effort cancelled thirty of the fifty westward newtons, leaving twenty newtons of unbeaten westward force. That is why 80 newtons — the scalar reflex answer — is so wrong.
visual_style: Tug-of-war arrows colliding head-on over a box, force bars cancelling segment by segment until a lone 20 N arrow survives pointing west.
pacing: Provocative hook, brisk sign-convention walkthrough, punchy cancellation payoff.
